## Treatments
- [Full Face Neurotoxin](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/neurotoxin/): Vixsthetics offers full face neurotoxin in Merrick, NY with Daxxify, Dysport, Jeuveau or Xeomin. Victoria Yunaev, PA-C, plans the forehead, frown lines and crow's feet together, chooses the product at your consultation, and performs every treatment herself.
- [Lip Filler](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/lip-filler/): Vixsthetics offers lip filler in Merrick, NY with the RHA Collection from Revance and the Restylane collection from Galderma, including Restylane Kysse. Victoria Yunaev, PA-C, shapes each result to your face, from a soft refresh to a fuller look.
- [Lip Flip](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/lip-flip/): A lip flip uses a small dose of neurotoxin along the upper lip border. The muscle relaxes slightly, so more of the upper lip shows. It adds no volume. At Vixsthetics in Merrick, NY, Victoria Yunaev, PA-C, will tell you whether a lip flip or lip filler fits your goal.
- [Facial Balancing](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/facial-balancing/): Facial balancing is filler planned across several areas at once, such as the chin, cheeks, jawline, temples and lips, to improve proportion. At Vixsthetics in Merrick, NY, Victoria Yunaev, PA-C, maps your face first and uses the RHA Collection and the Restylane collection.
- [Under Eye Treatments](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/under-eye/): Vixsthetics in Merrick, NY treats under eye hollows and a tired look with hyaluronic acid filler, PRP, PRF or PRF EZGel. The right option depends on why your under eyes look the way they do, so Victoria Yunaev, PA-C, decides with you at your consultation.
- [Sculptra](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/sculptra/): Sculptra is a biostimulator made of poly-L-lactic acid. Instead of adding instant volume, it helps your skin build its own collagen gradually over a series of treatments. Vixsthetics offers Sculptra in Merrick, NY with Victoria Yunaev, PA-C.
- [Radiesse (+)](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/radiesse/): Radiesse is a calcium hydroxylapatite filler that adds structure and supports collagen production. Radiesse (+) includes lidocaine for comfort. Vixsthetics in Merrick, NY also offers hyperdilute Radiesse, a thinner mix used to improve skin quality.
- [Microneedling](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/microneedling/): Microneedling uses a pen with fine needles to create tiny channels in the skin, which prompts the skin's own repair process. At Vixsthetics in Merrick, NY, microneedling is paired with Ariessence growth factor serum.
- [IV Therapy](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/iv-therapy/): Vixsthetics in Merrick, NY offers IV therapy for hydration and vitamins. Call (631) 408-8376 or book a consultation to ask which options are available and whether IV therapy is right for you.
- [Medical Weight Loss](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/medical-weight-loss/): Vixsthetics in Merrick, NY offers a guided medical weight loss program. It starts with a consultation and a review of your health history to decide whether the program is right for you.
- [Hair Restoration](https://vixsthetics.com/treatments/hair-restoration/): Vixsthetics in Merrick, NY offers hair restoration. Options depend on the cause of thinning, so treatment starts with a consultation.

## Resources
- [Daxxify, Dysport, Jeuveau or Xeomin: How to Choose](https://vixsthetics.com/blog/daxxify-vs-jeuveau-vs-xeomin/): Daxxify, Dysport, Jeuveau and Xeomin are all FDA approved botulinum toxin type A products for frown lines. Dysport is dosed in its own units, Xeomin is purified to remove accessory proteins, Jeuveau was developed for aesthetic use, and Daxxify uses a peptide based formula that its manufacturer reports lasts longer for some patients. Your injector chooses based on your face, goals and history.
- [Lip Flip vs Lip Filler: Which Is Right for You?](https://vixsthetics.com/blog/lip-flip-vs-lip-filler/): A lip flip relaxes the muscle above the upper lip with a small dose of neurotoxin so more of the lip shows. It adds no volume. Lip filler adds volume and can reshape the lip with hyaluronic acid. Choose a flip for a subtle change to how the upper lip sits, and filler for fullness or shape.
- [Sculptra vs Radiesse: How Biostimulators Differ](https://vixsthetics.com/blog/sculptra-vs-radiesse/): Sculptra and Radiesse are both biostimulators that help your skin make collagen. Sculptra (poly-L-lactic acid) works gradually over a series of sessions. Radiesse (calcium hydroxylapatite) gives some support right away and builds collagen over time. Neither can be dissolved like hyaluronic acid filler.
- [Under Eye Filler vs PRP vs PRF: What Is the Difference?](https://vixsthetics.com/blog/under-eye-filler-vs-prp-vs-prf/): Under eye filler uses hyaluronic acid to soften a hollow by replacing volume. PRP and PRF are made from your own blood and are used to support the skin, usually over a series. PRF EZGel turns PRF into a gel. Which one fits depends on why your under eyes look tired.
- [Your First Neurotoxin Appointment: What to Expect](https://vixsthetics.com/blog/first-neurotoxin-appointment/): A first neurotoxin appointment starts with a conversation about what you want to soften and keep. Your injector watches how your face moves, explains the product and dose, then treats with a fine needle in a few minutes. Most people return to their day, and results settle in about two weeks.
- [What Is Facial Balancing?](https://vixsthetics.com/blog/what-is-facial-balancing/): Facial balancing is filler planned across several areas, such as the chin, cheeks, jawline, temples and lips, to improve proportion. Instead of treating one feature, the injector adds support where it changes the whole face.
